app.local: Tools and data stay on this device

permission.intro: Pixo needs these permissions to record the clipboard, place the quick panel beside the text field, and receive the keyboard. It adds itself to the list in System Settings. You have to turn each switch on.
permission.restart: If a switch is on but still shows as needed here, quit Pixo completely and open it again.
permission.accessibility: Places the quick panel beside the current text field and lets it receive the keyboard, including Esc.
permission.inputMonitoring: Lets the quick panel receive keystrokes while it is open.
permission.pasteboard: Records copies in the background. In System Settings, set Pixo to Always Allow.

json.description: Format, compact, and check JSON data.
json.invalid: Invalid JSON. Check your input and try again.
json.copyError: Could not copy. Please copy the result manually.

clipboard.description: Keep text, images, and file paths on this computer so you can copy them again.
clipboard.settingsDescription: Choose what to record, how long to keep it, and the shortcut for the quick panel.
clipboard.privacy: History stays on this computer and is never uploaded. You can review what is stored, and where, before turning it on.
clipboard.empty: Nothing here yet. Copied items will show up after you turn history on.
clipboard.panelHint: Copied. You can paste it now.
clipboard.panelHelp: Use arrow keys to choose, Enter to copy, Esc to close, and Ctrl or Command+P to pin.
clipboard.panelHelpSelect: Arrow keys or a click select an item and copy it. Enter closes the panel, Esc closes it, and Ctrl or Command+P pins.
clipboard.copyOnSelect: Applies in the quick panel. Selecting an item copies it to the clipboard. Enter closes the panel.
clipboard.enableBody: Pixo stores copied text, images, and file paths locally, and skips content the system marks as sensitive. You can pause, delete, or clear it at any time.
clipboard.waylandShortcut: This Wayland session cannot register a global shortcut. Open the quick panel with pixo --clipboard-panel.
clipboard.skippedTooLarge_one: Skipped {{count}} item over the size limit.
clipboard.skippedTooLarge_other: Skipped {{count}} items over the size limit.
clipboard.skippedExcluded_one: Skipped {{count}} item from an excluded app.
clipboard.fileMissing_one: {{count}} file is no longer at its original path. The list was still copied.
clipboard.fileMissing_other: {{count}} files are no longer at their original paths. The list was still copied.
clipboard.retentionZero: Use 0 to keep items until the count limit removes them.
clipboard.excludedHelp: One app identifier per line. It must match the source shown on an item exactly.
clipboard.excludedPicker: Choose from the apps installed on this Mac. Copies from a selected app are not recorded.
clipboard.excludedLimit: You can exclude up to 100 apps.
clipboard.excludedWayland: This Wayland session cannot identify the source app, so this exclusion list has no effect.
clipboard.macosAccess: Opening Pixo asks for these system permissions. For the clipboard, choose Always Allow in System Settings.
clipboard.shortcutHelp: Click the field and press the new shortcut. Esc cancels. Include Command, Control, Option, or Shift. If the shortcut cannot be registered, this change is not saved.
clipboard.shortcutNeedModifier: Press it together with a modifier key.
clipboard.kindDisabled: This kind of content is turned off in settings.

statusReason.wayland_no_data_control: This Wayland session does not offer a clipboard monitoring protocol.
statusReason.no_display: No usable display session was found.
statusReason.platform: Clipboard monitoring is unavailable on this platform.

error.unsupported: This action is not available in the current environment.
error.busy: The clipboard is busy. Try again in a moment.
error.too_large: The content is over the size limit.
error.file_missing: The original file no longer exists.
error.storage: The local history could not be saved.
error.shortcut_conflict: That shortcut could not be registered.
error.needs_confirm: This change deletes existing items and needs confirmation.
error.desktop_only: Clipboard history is available in the Pixo desktop app.
error.unknown: The action did not finish. Try again.

system.description: Manage how Pixo starts and closes.
system.autostart: Start Pixo automatically when you sign in.
system.background: Keep Pixo running after closing the window. On macOS, hide the Dock icon and use the menu bar to reopen or quit.
system.error: Could not update the setting. Check system permissions and the menu bar icon, then try again.
system.desktopOnly: General settings are only available in the Pixo desktop app.
